about: Maya's own mesh tools (and Bonus Tools'), one node each in the flow editor. Each takes a model, runs one tool in Maya (mayapy, no window) and hands on an FBX. scripts/maya_mesh.py runs them; crates/amald/src/flow.rs makes the nodes from this list.

ops.title: Clean up mesh
ops.about: Maya's Mesh > Cleanup: non-manifold edges and vertices split, lamina and zero-area faces removed, close vertices merged - what image-to-3D meshes need before any other tool

ops.title: Remove floating bits
ops.about: Separates the mesh into its pieces and keeps the big ones: the small loose blobs image-to-3D leaves around a model go

widgets.name: keep
widgets.about: a piece smaller than this share of the biggest one is removed

ops.title: N-sided to quads
ops.about: Bonus Tools' Convert N-Sided Faces to Quads: faces with more than four sides are triangulated and joined into quads

widgets.name: angle
widgets.about: largest angle between two triangles that may be joined

ops.title: Triangles to quads
ops.about: Maya's Quadrangulate: pairs of triangles become quads where the result is clean

widgets.name: angle
widgets.about: largest angle between two triangles that may be joined

ops.title: Triangulate
ops.about: Every face becomes triangles (what game engines take in the end)

ops.title: Retopologize
ops.about: Maya's Retopologize: a new, even, all-quad mesh over the model at about this many faces (falls back to Reduce + Quadrangulate where Retopologize is not available); UVs are made fresh

ops.title: Reduce
ops.about: Maya's Reduce: fewer triangles, the shape kept, borders kept

ops.title: Smooth
ops.about: Maya's Smooth: each face divided and rounded

ops.title: Mirror half
ops.about: Maya's Mirror (cut): one half of the model mirrored onto the other across the middle, the seam merged

ops.title: Merge vertices
ops.about: Maya's Merge: vertices closer than the distance become one

ops.title: Fill holes
ops.about: Maya's Fill Hole: every open border is closed with a face

ops.title: Soften edges
ops.about: Maya's Soften/Harden Edge: edges under the angle are soft, sharper ones hard

ops.title: Auto UVs
ops.about: Fresh UVs: Maya's automatic projection, Unfold3D's unfold and layout (a texture made for the old UVs needs baking again - the Game-ready clean-up does that)

ops.title: Stand on the floor
ops.about: Transforms frozen, pivot at the feet, the model centred standing on the floor - and scaled to a height when one is given

widgets.name: height
widgets.about: height in cm (0 keeps its size)

ops.title: Conform normals
ops.about: Mesh Display > Conform: every face turned to face the same way as most of its neighbours (image-to-3D meshes often have patches flipped inside out)

ops.title: Reverse normals
ops.about: Mesh Display > Reverse: every face turned to face the other way

ops.title: Harden edges
ops.about: Edges sharper than the angle shade hard, the rest soft (Mesh Display > Soften/Harden by angle, normals unlocked first)

widgets.name: angle
widgets.about: edges at a sharper angle than this shade hard (degrees)

ops.title: Remesh
ops.about: Mesh > Remesh: the surface rebuilt from even triangles about this size - a clean, even base for Retopologize or sculpting

widgets.name: size
widgets.about: edge length of the new triangles (cm)

ops.title: Relax
ops.about: Mesh > Average Vertices: lumps and noise smoothed out without adding faces

ops.title: Bevel hard edges
ops.about: Edit Mesh > Bevel on the hard edges (sharper than the angle): rounded edges that catch the light, as game props use

widgets.name: segments
widgets.about: rows of faces across the bevel

ops.title: Centre pivot
ops.about: Modify > Center Pivot and Freeze Transformations: the model's pivot at its middle, its transforms zeroed
